checkout-timeout.title: Checkout authorize timeouts runbook
checkout-timeout.body: If checkout-api logs show upstream timeouts to payments-worker: 1) confirm payments-worker status is down/degraded, 2) check its db dependency, 3) do NOT raise checkout timeouts blindly — shed authorize retries to 1 and page payments on-call.

payment-retries.title: Payment authorize retry policy
payment-retries.body: Authorize retries are capped at 3 with backoff; repeated context-deadline-exceeded means the downstream worker is saturated or down — stop retrying and fail open to the queued-payments flow.
